# Project 29: Book Notes & Insights Library

**Category:** 4. Learning, Research & Knowledge
**Status:** Pending. Not started; work begins only on the explicit command `Start Project 29`.

## Brief (from the source PDF)

Organizes book highlights and notes into themes and actionable lessons.

> Original: Book highlights aur notes ko themes aur actionable lessons mein organize karta hai.
